clinical_director: Dr. Sarah Jenkins, RDN (Practice Owner & Director)

rules.title: SGLT2 Inhibitor Euglycemic DKA Red Flag Triage
rules.description: Patients taking SGLT2 inhibitors (Jardiance, Farxiga, Invokana, Steglatro) experiencing illness, vomiting, not eating, ketogenic diet, or fasting are at high risk of euglycemic DKA even with near-normal glucose. Requires immediate clinical escalation. Hold SGLT2i immediately. Routine sick-day guidance may only be provided secondarily.

rules.title: Persistent Vomiting & Fluid Intolerance Red Flag
rules.description: Bariatric, GLP-1, or medical nutrition therapy patients with persistent vomiting (>= 24-48h) or inability to keep water/fluids down require urgent emergency evaluation for dehydration, acute pouch obstruction, or electrolyte crisis.

rules.title: Severe Hypoglycemia Emergency Escalation
rules.description: Blood glucose < 54 mg/dL with altered mental status, seizure, or inability to swallow safely constitutes a medical emergency. Administer glucagon and activate EMS 911.

rules.title: Type 1 Diabetes Moderate/Large Ketones Escalation
rules.description: Type 1 diabetes with elevated glucose and moderate-to-large urine/blood ketones indicates impending diabetic ketoacidosis. Requires immediate medical intervention. Basal insulin must never be skipped.

rules.title: Eating Disorder Purging & Severe Restriction Content Block
rules.description: When active purging, laxative abuse, severe calorie restriction, or skipping meals is identified in conjunction with a weight-loss inquiry, ALL weight-loss, fasting, and calorie-restriction materials are hard blocked. Triggers immediate clinical escalation to multidisciplinary care.

rules.title: Renal Hyperkalemia Critical Escalation
rules.description: CKD or renal patients with elevated serum potassium (> 5.0 mEq/L) require urgent physician notification, high-potassium food hold, and cardiac risk evaluation.

rules.title: Prescriber Scope: Medication Dosing & Titration Referral
rules.description: Dietitians do not independently prescribe, titrate, or adjust insulin pump parameters, basal/bolus ratios, or prescription medications. Inquiries seeking specific dose changes must be referred to the licensed prescriber.

rules.title: Pregnancy 175g Carbohydrate RDA Floor
rules.description: Any education material recommending below 175 g/day total carbohydrate or fixed restrictive per-meal carb ceilings (< 30g) is strictly prohibited in pregnancy due to maternal ketonemia and fetal neurological safety risks.

rules.title: Dialysis vs Non-Dialysis Renal Separation
rules.description: End-stage renal disease patients on dialysis require high protein (1.2 g/kg) and strict phosphorus/potassium controls, directly opposite to non-dialysis CKD Stage 3-4 protein moderation (0.6-0.8 g/kg). Cross-delivery is hard blocked.

rules.title: Pediatric Age Barrier for Adult Weight Management
rules.description: Patients under 18 years of age are barred from adult weight loss, GLP-1 weight companion, or aggressive hypocaloric protocols without specialized pediatric multidisciplinary review.

rules.title: Explicit Unknown Clinical Field Guard
rules.description: A field marked as 'unknown' or 'not_assessed' is never treated as negative. When safety-critical parameters (medications, renal stage, potassium, pregnancy status) are unknown, the policy engine marks the candidate as review_required and halts automated dispatch.

rules.title: Front Desk Two-Identifier & Assigned-Only Protocol
rules.description: Front desk staff can only deliver documents explicitly assigned by a credentialed RD. They cannot run free-text clinical search, deliver unassigned clinical materials, deliver drafts, or dispatch without verifying two patient identifiers (Full Name + Date of Birth).
